item.title: How to add an event listener in JavaScript
item.description: Adding event listeners is fundamental to creating interactive web applications that respond to user actions like clicks, key presses, and form submissions. As the creator of CoreUI, a widely used open-source UI library, I’ve implemented thousands of event listeners in interactive components. From my experience, the most robust method is using addEventListener() which provides better control and flexibility than inline event handlers. This modern approach supports multiple listeners and prevents conflicts.
